LESSON: THE NATIONAL

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social
Topic 2.1.5: The National

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The National. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify colours of the Kenya National flag as a National symbol
2. demonstrate respect for the Kenya national flag as a National symbol
3. Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. flag of Kenya.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify colours of the Kenya National flag as a National symbol
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify colours of the Kenya National flag as a National symbol. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate respect for the Kenya national flag as a National symbol
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate respect for the Kenya national flag as a National symbol. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. flag of Kenya.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. flag of Kenya. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The National.
2. Explain The National to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: identify colours of the Kenya National flag as a National symbol
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The National. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The National important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
